item.title: Windows POS 1.0.6+7
item.description:
Windows POS 1.0.6+7
- Storage-ready SMS is sent immediately when the saved order's due date is today (America/Los_Angeles). - Storage-ready and storage-resend SMS share a limit of one message per store, customer and Pacific calendar day. Concurrent requests and scheduled sends use the same server-side guard. - Uncertain provider responses remain blocked for the day to prevent duplicate delivery; explicit provider rejections allow retry. - Windows update checks use the Windows certificate store and fall back to the signed update feed when the GitHub API is unavailable. - Includes the Scheduled message table's Select heading action.
The app checks for updates automatically; installation starts when staff choose Update after saving their work. Older installations with certificate errors may need this installer once to repair update checking.
